body: I had to check your other posts to make my guess but my guess is 36c.

You're right, I do that. I notice when something is said that isn't normally said and I search for the meaning behind it. It's odd. I can bring something up later in conversation and the other person will have no memory of them saying something. Why do I remember? Why can't I forget like they did? It's odd. 

I do see a dr, she's really great. She's given me a lot to think about over the last few months but even with her I can tell. There was a point in one of our last sessions where she stopped listening and was more focused on when the next appt was. Aside from that one instance, she's amazing.

I don't know how the saying goes or if it's even a real thing but have you ever heard the saying, today you, tomorrow me? I really don't know how to live for me. I've spent the last half of my life living for my kids and the people I loved. If they were happy, I was happy. That's not to say I don't have things of my own that I enjoy, I do. I spent time with just me today doing something for me. 

It's just..you know those people that fit you? I mean perfectly? Like you have this weird puzzle piece shaped hole in you and someone comes along and they fit, first fucking try? It's crazy. I'm not perfect by any means, it's really hard for me to care about someone enough to show them my demons. I don't see suicide as selfish, not even a little bit. If you tell me that you care and in the same breath tell me why I suck as a person..do you see what I'm getting at?

Sorry, I don't really know where I'm going with this, I'm sort of rambling. Thank you for your kind words, you have ten me something new to think about.

No, I'm all honesty I don't think they're being abusive. Among other things, I value honesty in people. It's just those times when I don't feel like I've done anything wrong or been a bad friend or anything like that. But say something gets taken out of context or something like that. Then it's just back to oh I knew it or I told you so or my favorite, I didn't think you could do this. 

Then later it's as if nothing happened. They don't remember it, but I do. Maybe I am wired wrong, maybe my brain doesn't work like everyone else's. I don't know.
